name: Adyen N.V.
research_rationale: Research is neutral on hold: filed FY2025 growth and positive FCF are unchanged, but unverified screen TTM FCF and the planned co-CEO handover offer no new basis to move past patience.

Dutch coverage (28 Oct) reported sharp share falls despite ~23% revenue-growth headlines; no new indexed filing metrics appear since the prior verdict refresh.
